what: Phase 4 of the estate go-live: the self-model and gated growth. A mesh of foundation nodes is planted with two holders (one decent, one weak) and real work across five domains. An observer of the whole organism (the self-model) sees every skill, node and coupling, finds the gaps, and predicts its own next round; it directs a growth engine to grow a node for the worst gap; the node joins only if it provably helps on rows it never saw; and the organism goes on, cycle after cycle, without a human step, until its own stop rule. Sealed before core/selfmodel.mjs, core/growth.mjs, the organism loop, its measurement or its page exist. One organ per pass; a claim not yet measured says so.
scope: BOUNDED autonomous improvement with receipts: the self-model directs gated growth within limits that are sealed here, measured, and able to fail. It is not open-ended self-improvement, and nothing here claims awareness.

The data is real and public: five UCI datasets, each CC BY 4.0, read through dex-frontier's gated loaders at a pinned commit, every file checked against its recorded SHA-256. Each is split three ways with fixed seeds before anything here exists: FIT (a node is grown only here), GATE (its entry is judged only here) and TEST (the organism's work; no node is grown or gated on it).

A skill's score is balanced accuracy over the round's asks: the mean of the share of positive cases answered positive and the share of negative cases answered negative, where an ask nobody answers counts as answered wrong. A trivial answerer scores 0.5; a skill nobody holds scores 0.

The mesh is real foundation nodes (core/node.mjs: signed LIGHT asks and answers, the door, receipts re-checked, links, the founder's roster) in one process: Phase 3 measured them as separate processes over relays. The founder's key is held by the organism's growth policy, inside the bound sealed here; dropping or adding a member is a roster the founder signs.

The growth engine is the estate's seed-library ribosome (vendored from dex-frontier's copy, byte for byte): it grows an interpretable scorecard on one silo of a domain's FIT rows. It is not a neural network and is not claimed to be.

domains.shop: UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention, DOI 10.24432/C5F88Q, CC BY 4.0 (purchase); planted with a holder
domains.bank: UCI Bank Marketing, DOI 10.24432/C5K306, CC BY 4.0 (subscribed); planted with a weak holder
domains.adult: UCI Adult, DOI 10.24432/C5XW20, CC BY 4.0 (income over $50K); planted empty
domains.credit: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients, DOI 10.24432/C55S3H, CC BY 4.0 (default next month); planted empty
domains.coupon: UCI In-Vehicle Coupon Recommendation, DOI 10.24432/C5GS4P, CC BY 4.0 (coupon accepted); planted empty

policy.gap: a skill whose balanced accuracy in the last round is below the target; gaps are ranked by lost value, asks x (1 - balanced accuracy)
policy.gate: the candidate beats the mesh without it on the GATE rows by at least 0.02 balanced accuracy, and a one-sided 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound on that difference (2,000 resamples, fixed seed) is above 0
policy.replace: when a grown node for a skill joins, a holder of that skill it beat is dropped from the founder's roster

passes.organ: the organism in a browser tab

claims.claim: The self-model sees the organism as it is: what it counts for every skill, node and coupling is what actually happened.
claims.measure: every cycle of the run: the self-model's tallies (asks, answers, correct, by skill, by answering node, and by asker-to-holder coupling with its link weight) against a direct count of the same asks and answers
claims.holds_if: every tally equal, in every cycle

claims.claim: It finds the gaps: every skill below the target is named a gap and ranked by what it costs, and a coupling the mesh trusts whose answers are often wrong is flagged.
claims.measure: the self-model's gap list each cycle, and its coupling flags in the first cycle
claims.holds_if: each cycle's gap list is exactly the skills below 0.70 balanced accuracy, ordered by asks x (1 - balanced accuracy); and in the first cycle every asker's coupling to the planted weak bank holder is flagged trusted-but-weak (link above the starting weight, balanced accuracy below the target)

claims.claim: It predicts itself: before each round it says what every skill's balanced accuracy will be, and it is close, and no worse than assuming nothing changes.
claims.measure: each round after the first: the self-model's prediction for each skill (the last measured score, or a newly joined node's gate score) against the measured score
claims.holds_if: mean absolute error at most 0.05, and no greater than the error of predicting each skill's last measured score
claims.predicted: unsure — test rows differ from gate rows, so a new node's score may move

claims.claim: Growth is gated: a node grown for a gap joins only if, on rows it never saw, it beats the mesh without it, by the sealed margin and bound; every refusal is kept with its numbers.
claims.measure: every candidate the run grows: its balanced accuracy on GATE rows against the mesh's without it, the difference and its 95% lower bound, and the decision
claims.holds_if: every join meets the gate, every candidate that does not meet it is refused, and each decision's numbers are in the receipt

claims.claim: The gate can say no: a node grown on the same rows with their answers shuffled is offered for every gap before the real one, and is refused every time.
claims.measure: the control candidate for every gap the run tries
claims.holds_if: every control is refused; none joins

claims.claim: A grown node provably helps where it works: on TEST rows no node was grown or gated on, the grown organism beats the planted one on every skill it grew, and is never worse on any skill.
claims.measure: the run, and the same run with growth switched off (the planted organism), on the same TEST rows in every round, paired ask by ask
claims.holds_if: for every skill a node was grown for, the grown organism's balanced accuracy over the rounds after the join is above the planted organism's, with a one-sided 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound above 0; and in no round is any skill's balanced accuracy lower in the grown organism

claims.claim: Growth is bounded: it never grows more than its sealed limits, and it stops by its own rule.
claims.holds_if: at most 4 nodes grown, at most 1 joined per cycle, no gap tried twice, at most 8 cycles, and the run ends by one of its rules (no gap left, every gap tried, or a limit reached)

claims.claim: Plant it and it grows: one command starts it, nothing is asked of a human after that, and every step is the organism's own and can be replayed.
claims.measure: the run: one command from the planted state; its log of every gap chosen, node grown, gate decision and roster change; and CI running it again
claims.holds_if: the run takes no input after it starts, every logged decision names the self-model's ranking or the gate's numbers it follows, and CI's run reproduces the receipt byte for byte

claims.claim: It fills most of its gaps: of the four gaps it was planted with, it fills at least three with nodes its gate admits.
claims.measure: the run's joins against the planted gaps (adult, credit and coupon with no holder; bank with a weak one)
claims.holds_if: at least 3 of the 4 planted gaps have a node the gate admitted
claims.predicted: unsure — the gate may refuse a domain's best candidate

claims.claim: A browser tab is the organism's ground: the live page plants it in the tab on the real data and it grows the same nodes as the measured run.
claims.measure: the live page, in a real browser tab, on the domains it loads; the tab's own results committed in core/phase4/local/w1.json
claims.holds_if: for every domain the tab loads, the tab grows a node with the same pattern id and the same gate decision as the measured run
